courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 繞射光學元件製作
related.transfer: 可遷移「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」與「聚焦效率、PSF 與 Strehl 量測」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；繞射光學元件製作的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" and "Focusing efficiency, PSF and Strehl measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Diffractive optical-element fabrication must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從超穎原子相位庫到 EBL／DUV 曝光、高深寬比蝕刻與聚焦效率驗收的平面透鏡製程工程；繞射光學元件製作則以以純量繞射效率、相位階數與蝕刻深度控制，把微影製作的繞射元件做到可驗收的效率與零級洩漏為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on from meta-atom phase libraries to EBL/DUV exposure, high-aspect-ratio etching and focusing-efficiency acceptance of flat lenses; Diffractive optical-element fabrication centres on bringing lithographically made diffractive elements to acceptable efficiency and zero-order leakage through scalar efficiency, phase-level count and etch-depth control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」與「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到繞射光學元件製作，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「效率預算：量化、深度、套準與散射」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice” and “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Diffractive optical-element fabrication, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Efficiency budget: quantisation, depth, overlay and scatter", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 超穎透鏡製程研究
history.text: 2011 年哈佛 Capasso 團隊以電漿子天線陣列提出廣義 Snell 定律，2016 年同團隊以 TiO₂ 奈米柱做出可見光高 NA 超穎透鏡，開啟以半導體製程製作透鏡的研究路線；Metalenz 於 2016 年由該團隊衍生成立，2022 年與 STMicroelectronics 把超穎表面光學元件導入 300 mm 半導體產線的飛時測距模組。2024 年哈佛團隊以 DUV 投影微影與場拼接做出直徑 10 公分、含約 187 億根奈米柱的全玻璃超穎透鏡並拍攝太陽與星雲。本課只重建公開物理與製程邏輯，不含任何專有配方。
history.textEn: In 2011 the Capasso group at Harvard proposed the generalized Snell law with plasmonic antenna arrays, and in 2016 the same group demonstrated a visible high-NA metalens from TiO₂ nanopillars, opening the route of making lenses with semiconductor processes; Metalenz spun out of that group in 2016 and in 2022, with STMicroelectronics, brought metasurface optics into time-of-flight modules on 300 mm semiconductor lines. In 2024 the Harvard team used DUV projection lithography with field stitching to build a 10 cm all-glass metalens of about 18.7 billion nanopillars and imaged the Sun and a nebula. This course reconstructs only public physics and process logic, with no proprietary recipe.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「廣義 Snell 定律與相位取樣」到「關鍵尺寸預算與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Generalized Snell law and phase sampling" through "Critical-dimension budget and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

courses.connection: 從「超穎透鏡製程研究」的元件、量測或系統整合延伸到下列廠商與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the components, measurements or system integration of Metalens fabrication research. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.

vendors.name: Metalenz
vendors.business: 由哈佛衍生的超穎表面光學公司，設計以半導體製程量產的超穎透鏡與偏振感測元件。
vendors.businessEn: Harvard spin-out designing metasurface lenses and polarization-sensing optics for production on semiconductor lines.

vendors.name: NIL Technology
vendors.business: 丹麥公司，以奈米壓印與半導體製程製作超穎光學元件、繞射元件與母模。
vendors.businessEn: Danish company making meta-optical elements, diffractive optics and master molds by nanoimprint and semiconductor processes.

vendors.name: 意法半導體
vendors.business: 歐洲半導體製造商，於 300 mm 產線量產超穎表面光學元件並用於飛時測距感測模組。
vendors.businessEn: European semiconductor manufacturer producing metasurface optics on 300 mm lines for time-of-flight sensing modules.

vendors.name: 日本電子
vendors.business: 電子顯微鏡（SEM、TEM）、電子束微影與分析儀器製造。
vendors.businessEn: Manufacturer of electron microscopes (SEM, TEM), electron-beam lithography and analytical instruments.
